question: Why is Ekajaṭā alone the deity of other vidyās?
premises: this is due to her being the primal nature
inference: Ekajaṭā is the sole deity of other vidyās because she is their primal nature
uncertainties: devathā appears instead of the more common devatā; taken as deity
plain_english: Ekajaṭā alone is the deity of other vidyās, because she is their primal nature.
